gui.description: Qt6 Widgets MIDAS verification GUI (apps/verification-gui) plus its Qt-independent verification/ library (ExcelReferenceReader, via xlnt for .xlsx); not built by default, requested only via -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=gui so the routine Ubuntu CI matrix in ci.yml never builds Qt6/xlnt from source. qtbase is requested with default-features:false + an explicit minimal {core,gui,widgets} list -- apps/verification-gui only ever uses QtWidgets/QtGui/QtCore (QMainWindow, QFileDialog, QProcess, QSettings, ...), never QtNetwork/QtSql/QtDBus/QtConcurrent/ICU text shaping/OpenGL -- which qtbase's bare default-features (dbus, sql-psql, sql-sqlite, testlib, icu, harfbuzz, brotli, network, opengl, openssl, async-io, sessionmanager, dnslookup, zstd) all unconditionally pulled in, exhausting a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner's disk building them from source (GUI-7, 2026-10-21). windeployqt is requested only on Windows (platform-filtered), since it is a Windows-only deployment tool with no effect on Linux.
